connector.name: Wsjtx MCP
connector.registryDescription: Operate WSJT-X (FT8/FT4/WSPR) from MCP clients over its UDP message protocol.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package wsjtx-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sbrunner-atx account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: WSJTX_CALLSIGN
env.description: Operator callsign — the single transmit gate. Blank = receive-only (refuses all transmit-initiating messages).

env.name: WSJTX_HOST
env.description: Address to bind/receive WSJT-X UDP broadcasts on. For a remote WSJT-X use 127.0.0.1 with the mcp-host-bridge 'wsjtx' service and set the port to 2238.

env.name: WSJTX_PORT
env.description: WSJT-X Settings → Reporting → UDP Server port. Default 2237. Enable 'Accept UDP requests' for control.

env.name: WSJTX_MULTICAST
env.description: Optional multicast group to join so multiple UDP consumers can coexist. Blank = unicast.

env.name: WSJTX_INSTANCE
env.description: Optional WSJT-X instance Id to target when several broadcast here.
